actions.script: if (!ec.user.hasPermission('MONITOR_EVAL')) { ec.message.addError(ec.l10n.localize('This needs the MONITOR_EVAL permission')); return } datasetId = ec.service.sync().name('create#moqui.agent.AgentDataset').parameters({datasetId: datasetId || null, datasetName, description, agentId: agentId || null, versionNum: 0, createdDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp}).disableAuthz().call()?.datasetId

label.text: A dataset is the test cases for an agent: an input, and what a good answer has (expected output). Each change makes a new version, and an experiment keeps the version it ran. Add cases here, or save a real run as a case from Runs.
